logical_hash_includes: filing identity: family + slot + source_registration_no (nreg / registro oficial)
taxonomy selection: observed schemaRef URIs + pinned package names + package sha256
fact value_sha256 + value_len (multi-MB base64 facts compared by hash+length, never inlined)
revision/complementary event semantics (event_registration_no, target nregaud, type, date, doc locator)
logical_hash_excludes: log ordering and log noise (arelle-log kept as audit, not hashed)
explicitly_not_excluded: ?e= verdocumento tokens — R4 declared them stable; a difference between runs MUST be detected
validity_precondition: source_state_A == source_state_B; if the normalized source observation differs, the run pair is inconclusive for pipeline determinism (drift is reported, not blamed on the pipeline)
negative_control: control_projection = artifact manifest + retrieved_at + IPP ?t={GUID}; A/B hashes MUST differ — proves the normalizer removes real volatility
